state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 9 (the AD extras) is done**: sort with a VLV window, deleted objects, DirSync and the Global Catalog are on `main`, and all four tests of `nvs-stdlib-ldap-ad-extras` pass (`a_write_to_a_global_catalog_block_throws_before_it_is_sent` runs against a scripted peer on loopback port 3268 or 3269, no Samba needed). Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done. Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Stage 6 is done except wiring the schema into the readers. Stage 10, the feature proofs, is what the driver's red checks now name: every `Core\Ldap*` member owes its `about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench and a Rust `covers:` marker.

**On `main`**: everything Stage 9 listed. `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs`'s module doc ("A Global Catalog only reads") says how the read-only check works: `Url::is_global_catalog` sets `Connection::read_only` at `open`, and `write` and `password_write` throw `Kind::ReadOnly` before anything is sent. A search and a compare still go through.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, and plain LDAP at 16389. Write cases add and delete their own entries under names no other case uses: OUs `Shop`/`Blog`/`Store`/`Framework`/`Example`/`Catalog`/`Library`/`Gallery`/`Studio`/`Archive`/`Theater`/`Cinema`/`Garden` (cases) and `Museum`/`Harbor` (Rust) at the root, and each test user `CN=<name>,OU=<name>` in an OU of its own (`Team`, `Editors`, `Visitors`, `Members`, `Readers` in Rust; `Staff`, `Authors`, `Owners`, `Clients` in cases). Grep the name across `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs` before taking one. A deleted entry cannot be removed, so a test that deletes must not assume it is the only tombstone.

items.text: **`Core\Ldap::connect` and `Core\Ldap::open` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench each, and a `covers:` marker on a Rust test (the grant tests at `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:107` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:159`). Registry rows at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:179`. `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Ldap::connect'` lists what is owed; every comment and `about.md` follows `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*, checked with `bun nv proofs --comments`.
**`Core\Ldap\Connection`'s members owe nothing**, the same proofs, one member at a time, starting with the writes at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs:59`; `bun nv proofs --owed` names them.

backlog: Stage 4: a CA that a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (ADR 0278 § 4).
Stage 6: wire the cached schema into the typed readers on `Ldap\Entry` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` module doc).
The remaining classes' proofs: `Entries`, `Changes`, `Entry`, `Filter`, `Dn`, `Change`, `Sid`, `Ad`, `Ad\AccountFlags`, `Ad\GroupType` (`bun nv proofs --owed`).
